uidx_categories_org_child_name.name: uidx_categories_org_child_name
uidx_categories_org_child_name.where: "categories"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "categories"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL

chk_customer_ledger_delta_sign.name: chk_customer_ledger_delta_sign
chk_customer_ledger_delta_sign.value: ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('opening_balance', 'sale_debt') AND "customer_ledger"."amount_delta" > 0) OR ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('debt_payment', 'return_offset') AND "customer_ledger"."amount_delta" < 0) OR ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" = 'adjustment' AND "customer_ledger"."amount_delta" <> 0)

chk_customer_ledger_payment_fields.name: chk_customer_ledger_payment_fields
chk_customer_ledger_payment_fields.value: ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" = 'debt_payment' AND "customer_ledger"."payment_method" IN ('cash', 'card', 'uzqr', 'payme', 'click', 'uzum', 'social_card', 'other') AND (("customer_ledger"."payment_method" = 'cash' AND "customer_ledger"."cash_move_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_ledger"."provider_ref" IS NULL) OR ("customer_ledger"."payment_method" <> 'cash' AND "customer_ledger"."cash_move_id" IS NULL))) OR ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" <> 'debt_payment' AND "customer_ledger"."payment_method" IS NULL AND "customer_ledger"."provider_ref" IS NULL AND "customer_ledger"."cash_move_id" IS NULL)

chk_customer_ledger_sale_ref.name: chk_customer_ledger_sale_ref
chk_customer_ledger_sale_ref.value: ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('sale_debt', 'return_offset') AND "customer_ledger"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("customer_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('opening_balance', 'debt_payment', 'adjustment'))

chk_customer_ledger_reason_req.name: chk_customer_ledger_reason_req
chk_customer_ledger_reason_req.value: "customer_ledger"."entry_type" NOT IN ('opening_balance', 'adjustment') OR ("customer_ledger"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("customer_ledger"."reason")) >= 1)

chk_customer_ledger_req_pair.name: chk_customer_ledger_req_pair
chk_customer_ledger_req_pair.value: ("customer_ledger"."client_request_id" IS NULL AND "customer_ledger"."request_hash" IS NULL) OR ("customer_ledger"."client_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_ledger"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("customer_ledger"."request_hash")) >= 6)

uidx_customers_org_phone_active.name: uidx_customers_org_phone_active
uidx_customers_org_phone_active.where: "customers"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL AND "customers"."phone_normalized" IS NOT NULL

idx_customers_org_phone_digits.name: idx_customers_org_phone_digits
idx_customers_org_phone_digits.where: "customers"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL AND "customers"."phone_digits" IS NOT NULL

chk_customers_phone_e164.name: chk_customers_phone_e164
chk_customers_phone_e164.value: "customers"."phone_normalized" IS NULL OR ("customers"."phone_normalized" GLOB '+[1-9]*' AND length("customers"."phone_normalized") BETWEEN 9 AND 16)

chk_customers_phone_pair.name: chk_customers_phone_pair
chk_customers_phone_pair.value: ("customers"."phone_normalized" IS NULL AND "customers"."phone_digits" IS NULL) OR ("customers"."phone_normalized" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."phone_digits" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."phone_normalized" = ('+' || "customers"."phone_digits"))

chk_inv_count_lines_counted_snapshot.name: chk_inv_count_lines_counted_snapshot
chk_inv_count_lines_counted_snapshot.value: "inventory_count_lines"."counted_qty" IS NULL OR ("inventory_count_lines"."counted_qty" >= 0 AND "inventory_count_lines"."expected_qty_at_count" IS NOT NULL)

chk_inventory_counts_finalized_consisten.name: chk_inventory_counts_finalized_consistency
chk_inventory_counts_finalized_consisten.value: ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'open' AND "inventory_counts"."finalized_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_counts"."status" <> 'open' AND "inventory_counts"."finalized_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_local_cart_lines_kind_product.name: chk_local_cart_lines_kind_product
chk_local_cart_lines_kind_product.value: ("local_cart_lines"."line_kind" = 'catalog' AND "local_cart_lines"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("local_cart_lines"."line_kind" = 'quick_sale' AND "local_cart_lines"."product_id" IS NULL AND "local_cart_lines"."variant_id" IS NULL)

chk_local_carts_park_meta.name: chk_local_carts_park_meta
chk_local_carts_park_meta.value: ("local_carts"."status" IN ('open', 'completed') AND "local_carts"."parked_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("local_carts"."status" = 'parked' AND "local_carts"."parked_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_local_carts_completed_meta.name: chk_local_carts_completed_meta
chk_local_carts_completed_meta.value: ("local_carts"."status" <> 'completed' AND "local_carts"."completed_sale_id" IS NULL AND "local_carts"."completed_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("local_carts"."status" = 'completed' AND "local_carts"."completed_sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "local_carts"."completed_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_local_carts_disc_val.name: chk_local_carts_disc_val
chk_local_carts_disc_val.value: ("local_carts"."manual_discount_mode" = 'none' AND "local_carts"."manual_discount_value" = 0) OR ("local_carts"."manual_discount_mode" = 'percent' AND "local_carts"."manual_discount_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000) OR ("local_carts"."manual_discount_mode" = 'amount' AND "local_carts"."manual_discount_value" > 0)

chk_local_carts_override_pair.name: chk_local_carts_override_pair
chk_local_carts_override_pair.value: ("local_carts"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "local_carts"."override_approved_amount" IS NULL AND "local_carts"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("local_carts"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "local_carts"."override_approved_amount" >= 0 AND "local_carts"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_payments_cash_balance.name: chk_payments_cash_balance
chk_payments_cash_balance.value: ("payments"."method" = 'cash' AND "payments"."tendered_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."tendered_amount" > 0 AND "payments"."tendered_amount" >= "payments"."amount" AND "payments"."tendered_amount" - "payments"."change_amount" = "payments"."amount") OR ("payments"."method" <> 'cash' AND "payments"."tendered_amount" IS NULL AND "payments"."change_amount" = 0)

idx_product_barcodes_org_variant.name: idx_product_barcodes_org_variant
idx_product_barcodes_org_variant.where: "product_barcodes"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_barcodes"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL

uidx_product_variants_org_sku.name: uidx_product_variants_org_sku
uidx_product_variants_org_sku.where: "product_variants"."sku" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL

uidx_products_org_sku.name: uidx_products_org_sku
uidx_products_org_sku.where: "products"."sku" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL

idx_products_org_sku_search.name: idx_products_org_sku_search
idx_products_org_sku_search.where: "products"."sku_search" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."deleted_at_ms" IS NULL

chk_products_min_stock_unit_int.name: chk_products_min_stock_unit_int
chk_products_min_stock_unit_int.value: "products"."min_stock" IS NULL OR "products"."unit" NOT IN ('dona', 'qadoq') OR ("products"."min_stock" % 1000) = 0

chk_promotions_scope_targets.name: chk_promotions_scope_targets
chk_promotions_scope_targets.value: ("promotions"."scope" = 'product' AND "promotions"."target_product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."target_category_id" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."scope" = 'category' AND "promotions"."target_category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."target_product_id" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."scope" = 'all' AND "promotions"."target_product_id" IS NULL AND "promotions"."target_category_id" IS NULL)

chk_promotions_type_fields.name: chk_promotions_type_fields
chk_promotions_type_fields.value: ("promotions"."type" = 'percent' AND "promotions"."discount_percent_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "promotions"."discount_amount" IS NULL AND "promotions"."buy_qty" IS NULL AND "promotions"."free_qty" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."type" = 'fixed_amount' AND "promotions"."discount_amount" > 0 AND "promotions"."discount_percent_bp" IS NULL AND "promotions"."buy_qty" IS NULL AND "promotions"."free_qty" IS NULL) OR ("promotions"."type" = 'buy_x_get_y' AND "promotions"."buy_qty" >= 1 AND "promotions"."free_qty" >= 1 AND "promotions"."discount_percent_bp" IS NULL AND "promotions"."discount_amount" IS NULL)

chk_return_lines_kind_product.name: chk_return_lines_kind_product
chk_return_lines_kind_product.value: ("return_lines"."line_kind" = 'catalog' AND "return_lines"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("return_lines"."line_kind" = 'quick_sale' AND "return_lines"."product_id" IS NULL AND "return_lines"."variant_id" IS NULL)

chk_returns_override_pair.name: chk_returns_override_pair
chk_returns_override_pair.value: ("returns"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "returns"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("returns"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "returns"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_sale_lines_kind_product.name: chk_sale_lines_kind_product
chk_sale_lines_kind_product.value: ("sale_lines"."line_kind" = 'catalog' AND "sale_lines"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sale_lines"."line_kind" = 'quick_sale' AND "sale_lines"."product_id" IS NULL AND "sale_lines"."variant_id" IS NULL)

chk_sale_lines_money_nonneg.name: chk_sale_lines_money_nonneg
chk_sale_lines_money_nonneg.value: "sale_lines"."unit_price_snapshot" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."free_units" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."gross_total" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."promo_discount" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."subtotal_after_promo" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."allocated_order_discount" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."final_total" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."net_ex_vat" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."vat_total" >= 0 AND "sale_lines"."cost_value" >= 0

chk_sales_disc_val.name: chk_sales_disc_val
chk_sales_disc_val.value: ("sales"."manual_discount_mode" = 'none' AND "sales"."manual_discount_value" = 0) OR ("sales"."manual_discount_mode" = 'percent' AND "sales"."manual_discount_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000) OR ("sales"."manual_discount_mode" = 'amount' AND "sales"."manual_discount_value" > 0)

chk_sales_money_nonneg.name: chk_sales_money_nonneg
chk_sales_money_nonneg.value: "sales"."subtotal_gross" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_promo_discount" >= 0 AND "sales"."subtotal_after_promo" >= 0 AND "sales"."order_discount_amount" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_final" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_net_ex_vat" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_vat" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_paid" >= 0 AND "sales"."debt_amount" >= 0 AND "sales"."change_amount" >= 0

chk_sales_override_pair.name: chk_sales_override_pair
chk_sales_override_pair.value: ("sales"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "sales"."override_approved_amount" IS NULL AND "sales"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("sales"."override_approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."override_approved_amount" >= 0 AND "sales"."override_approved_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

chk_sales_void_pair.name: chk_sales_void_pair
chk_sales_void_pair.value: ("sales"."voided_at_ms" IS NULL AND "sales"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "sales"."void_reason" IS NULL AND "sales"."void_client_request_id" IS NULL AND "sales"."void_request_hash" IS NULL) OR ("sales"."voided_at_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."voided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("sales"."void_reason")) >= 1 AND "sales"."void_client_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."void_request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("sales"."void_request_hash")) >= 6)
